parameters.content:
## 1. A patient missed their visit
The GoHighLevel workflow "No-show to rebooking agent" calls this webhook a few minutes after an appointment is marked No-show. The agent reads the appointment back to make sure it is still a no-show and was not rebooked, then texts real open times (or queues the text until morning), tags the patient and moves the opportunity to No-show.

## Shared steps
Webhook answers for refused calls and bad settings, and the opportunity step used by the no-show path (stage No-show) and by bookings (stage Rebooked). A won opportunity is never reopened.

## 2. The patient answers
The GoHighLevel workflow "No-show replies to rebooking agent" forwards SMS replies from patients tagged no-show. STOP words set DND in code. A patient who already booked another way gets no answer and no second booking. Claude (forced tool call) decides: book an offered time, offer other real times, hand off to a person, close politely or ask a short question. Texts in quiet hours wait for the morning.

## 3. Every 15 minutes
Sends texts that waited for quiet hours to end, up to two gentle follow-ups to patients who never answered (fresh open times each time), and closes conversations that went quiet. Each patient is reloaded first: DND, a person taking over or a booking made another way stops the agent.

## 4. Daily summary
One Slack message a day: no-shows, rebooked, waiting, handed to a person, declined, no reply and opted out.
